exact_statement: For every integer L>=1, let f_L be the Boolean triangle with clauses {x,a,c}, X2 union {a,b}, X3 union {b,c}, with equal disjoint L-bit private blocks. Let W=17 I_private(f_L), where private={x} union X2 union X3, and D=M(f_L)+B_x(f_L)+mean_s B_b(p_s). After physical x=s,b=t, use supplied Q_st=fair_a(marg_a p_st). Choose y in X2, physically query y in all four parents and prescribe Qnew_stu=fair_c(marg_c p_stu) in all eight original-reach-1/8 terminals. Then D+mean_st B_y(p_st)+mean_stu CE(p_stu,Qnew_stu)<W-1/32. For each parent the exact net increment is Delta-rho=-I_p(S_y;S_c|S_-(c,y))-J_y^(minus c)<=0, while the actual incoming conditional-KL refund is rho=I_p(S_y;S_a|S_-(a,y)). The x=1,b=0 incoming y kernel is nonfair for all L, and equals49/218 at L2. This is an inherited-bank extension, not universal FEI and not a demonstrated positive-price nonfair reset.
